description: Issues an organization API key (owner only) and writes it to a server env file in the project, so the app can read it at runtime. Also saves it on this machine for the org-key tools. Returns the org, file, variable, and last four characters; never the key. Replaces an existing variable of the same name in the file, first appending the old value to `<envFile>.backup` (gitignored); tell the developer its path. Adds the file to .gitignore. Use when the app needs a key, or before `create_verification_session`.

envFile.description: Env file to write, relative to `projectDir`. Default `.env`.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the app's project directory.

name: issue_org_token
